title: review.v1
description: What the reviewer agent hands to the person's review (SUP.1 BP1, SWE.3 BP5): whether it asks for a person, what became of each finding over the review rounds, and, when a person reviews, each test described from the test alone. A fenced ```yaml review block in the reviewer agent's review, written by post_review_tool --record. That an approval carries one, and which pull requests a person reviews, are rules of verify_delivery_reviewed_gate (classify_pull_request_tool); the person's review is posted by post_checkpoint_review_tool.

person.description: none, or why a person must review: one of the five conditions no file shows — 1 the rating looks too low, 2 the meaning is unclear, 3 beyond what was approved, 4 cannot be undone, 5 cannot be verified (or the same finding after three rounds) — and what it concerns.

findings.description: Every finding of every round on this pull request: fixed by a change (re-checked by the reviewer), withdrawn by the reviewer, or disputed by the author and left without a change.

tests.description: Each test the person reviews, described in a session that saw the test only, never the requirement (agent/describe_tests_prompt.md): what it prepares, does and checks, and what a reader would expect that it leaves out.
